_comment: Real data, not fabricated: this is a frozen copy of an actual OSV.dev API response (https://api.osv.dev/v1/querybatch + /v1/vulns/{id}) captured live on 2026-08-22 for the exact packages/versions in data/demo_requirements.txt. Used as the offline/demo fixture so CI doesn't depend on network access, and so results are reproducible - not because the vulnerabilities themselves are made up. Severity labels for entries without an explicit OSV database_specific.severity are our own conservative classification (documented in osv_client.py's fallback logic), not an official score.

vulnerabilities.summary: Flask is vulnerable to Denial of Service via incorrect encoding of JSON data
